verdict.rationale: a-Shell is a Unix-like terminal that bundles the ios_system command set. The docs show `grep` in use (`help -l | grep command`), which implies regex search and pipe-based filtering, and Vim is included for in-file navigation and search. There is no direct evidence of fuzzy matching or of grep being used to search code content. missing for 10: fuzzy-finder tooling (e.g. fzf), documented recursive code-content search, explicit regex search documentation, hands-on corroboration.
